relabel.note: 24:14 is the one-off order to stone Shelomith's son; same-verse C0707/C0708 are historical. Standing penalty is 24:16; re-reference there if kept as law.
Conquest ban on the seven named nations; the same direction at Deut 7:2 (C0997) and 7:3 (C0998) is filed as historical.
Attitude prohibition, not a procedure; the matching 15:7-9 prohibitions C1037, C1038, C1040 are Torah Law. C1039/C1043 deserve the same review.
Attitude rule within the servant-release law, not a procedure; sibling C1042 (do not send him away empty-handed) is Torah Law.
Standing step of the priest's scall examination, not a one-off direction; siblings C0486, C0488, C0489 are Mosaic Instruction.
Colophon directing the priest to perform the jealousy procedure, whose steps are all Instruction; not a one-off historical direction.
Standing permission: Levites and households may eat their tithe anywhere as wages; parallels AUD-04-18-11. Not a one-off direction.
Generic 'when you go to war' charge, not one-off; the rest of Deut 20 has Mosaic types. Cf. C0959 (Torah Law); Mosaic Command possible.
The priest's address before any battle is a standing procedure, exactly like the officers' address C1093 (Mosaic Instruction).
Perpetual prohibition ('all your days for ever') among the assembly laws C1142-C1148, all Torah Law.

torah_law_not_laws.note: 24:14 is the one-off order to stone Shelomith's son; same-verse C0707/C0708 are historical. Standing penalty is 24:16; re-reference there if kept as law.
Conquest ban on the seven named nations; the same direction at Deut 7:2 (C0997) and 7:3 (C0998) is filed as historical.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Affix God's words (mezuzah) to doorposts and gates
613_mislabel_flags.note: Standing household rule like tassels (C0860, Torah Law), yet C0991 is Mosaic Instruction.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: The king must write a Torah scroll for himself
613_mislabel_flags.note: The king's prohibitions (C1060-C1064) are Torah Law; his scroll duty is Instruction.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Revere the sanctuary
613_mislabel_flags.note: Only C0636 (Mosaic Command) itemizes it, while 'revere father and mother' (C0595) is Torah Law; it reads as a standing rule.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Guard the sanctuary (Levitical watch)
613_mislabel_flags.note: Guard duty only as Command C0772 (Num 1:53; 3:7-8); C0874 holds 18:4 but states the outsider ban (N74).

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Levites perform their service in the sanctuary
613_mislabel_flags.note: Only Command C0768 and Commission AUD-05-10-8; Torah Law C0840 covers service ages only; the 18:23 clause has no record.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Priests wash hands and feet before sanctuary service
613_mislabel_flags.note: C0345 is Instruction despite 'perpetual statute' and 'so that they do not die'; the parallel undergarment rule C0301 (Ex 28:43) is Torah Law.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Priests bless Israel with the priestly blessing
613_mislabel_flags.note: Standing priestly duty under Instruction (Commission AUD-05-10-8 also names blessing); comparable priestly duty C0846 (trumpets) is Torah Law.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Send the ritually impure out of the camp (sanctuary)
613_mislabel_flags.note: Only Command C0796; parallel exclusion rules are Torah Law (C0494 leper outside camp, C1151 no re-entry), so this standing rule reads as Law.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Offer the two daily (tamid) lambs
613_mislabel_flags.note: Only Instruction C0333 (Num 28:3-8 attached), while Lev 23 festival offerings (C0681, C0694, C0699) are Torah Law.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Bring the additional Sabbath offering
613_mislabel_flags.note: Only Instruction C0928; festival additional offerings are Torah Law (C0694, C0696, C0699), so labelling is inconsistent.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Bring the additional new-moon offering
613_mislabel_flags.note: Only Instruction C0929; festival additional offerings are Torah Law elsewhere, so labelling is inconsistent.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Bring the additional Shavuot offering
613_mislabel_flags.note: Only Instruction AUD-04-28-27; Torah Law C0687 covers the Lev 23:18-19 loaves offerings, which Maimonides counts under P46.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Appear before the Lord at the sanctuary on the three festivals
613_mislabel_flags.note: Only topical study S134 (Deut 16:16-17, Ex 34:23-24); Ex 23:17 uncited; C0230 (Law) covers keeping the feasts at Ex 23:14.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Offer animals only from their eighth day onward
613_mislabel_flags.note: Lev 22:27 has no own record; only C0211 (Exod 22:29, Instruction) holds it, though offering-eligibility rules are Torah Law.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: A man cured of a discharge brings his offering
613_mislabel_flags.note: Instruction, while the woman's parallel (AUD-03-15-29), childbirth (C0483) and metzora (C0511) offerings are Torah Law.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Set apart the firstborn of clean animals as holy
613_mislabel_flags.note: C0115 is Command, C0212 Instruction; Deut 15:19's sanctify clause is unitemized, while firstborn rules C0119, C0877, C1045 are Torah Law.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Redeem the firstborn donkey with a lamb
613_mislabel_flags.note: C0118 (Instruction) cites Ex 34:20; the same verses' 'redeem firstborn sons' (C0119) is Torah Law.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Observe the impurity laws of a menstruating woman (niddah)
613_mislabel_flags.note: Lev 15:19-24 has no C/AUD record, only topical study S062; parallel discharge rules (C0533, AUD-03-15-25) are Torah Law.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Apply the valuation laws for consecrated animals
613_mislabel_flags.note: Valuation itself is Instruction C0743; Torah Law C0744 covers only the added fifth. Person and field valuations (C0740, C0747) are Torah Law.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Apply the valuation laws for consecrated houses
613_mislabel_flags.note: Valuation itself is Instruction C0745; Torah Law C0746 covers only the added fifth. Person and field valuations are Torah Law.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Separate the poor man's tithe in the third year
613_mislabel_flags.note: Standing poor-relief rule like gleanings (C0601, Torah Law), yet C1034 is Mosaic Instruction.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Sound the shofar on the Jubilee Day of Atonement
613_mislabel_flags.note: Jubilee shofar proclamation under Instruction while the Jubilee ordinance (C0718) is Torah Law; arguably procedural, flagged for review.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Count seven sabbatical cycles of years to the Jubilee
613_mislabel_flags.note: Count under Instruction while Jubilee rules (C0718, C0721-C0723) are Torah Law; arguably procedural, flagged for review.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Cover the blood of slaughtered wild animals and birds
613_mislabel_flags.note: C0574 (Instruction) states it, but it is an everyday rule for every hunter, not a sanctuary or purification procedure.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Send away the mother bird before taking the young
613_mislabel_flags.note: Standing rule filed as Instruction; its negative twin C1127 and comparable positive duties (C1129) are Torah Law.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Remove (destroy) all leaven by 14 Nisan
613_mislabel_flags.note: C0105 is typed Instruction while the paired bans C0109 (no leaven in houses) and AUD-02-13-7 are Torah Law.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Count the Omer: forty-nine days from the sheaf offering
613_mislabel_flags.note: Counting reads as a standing annual observance like festival rules labelled Torah Law; catalogue treats it as procedure (Deut 16:9 attached).

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Take the four species (lulav) on Sukkot
613_mislabel_flags.note: Annual observance binding all Israel, like dwelling in booths (C0704, Torah Law), yet labelled Instruction.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Obey the rulings of the supreme court
613_mislabel_flags.note: Negative twin C1056 is Torah Law; obeying the ruling is filed as referral procedure (Instruction).

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Appoint judges and officers in every town
613_mislabel_flags.note: Standing law at 16:18 has only S135; C0956 (1:13, Command) is a one-time appointment that notes 16:18.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Wipe out the descendants of Amalek
613_mislabel_flags.note: Standing judgment filed as historical direction while the parallel seven-nations judgment AUD-05-20-17 is Torah Law; arguably a one-time charge.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Give charity to the poor
613_mislabel_flags.note: Negative counterparts C1037-C1038 are Torah Law; the positive duty is Instruction (15:8) and Command (Lev 25:35).

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Give parting gifts to a freed Hebrew servant
613_mislabel_flags.note: Its negative twin C1042 (15:13) is Torah Law; the positive duty at 15:14 is Instruction.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Lend money to the poor
613_mislabel_flags.note: Ex 22:24 records state only pressing and interest; C1039 (Deut 15:8) is Instruction beside Torah Law C1037, C1038, C1040.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Rebuke a neighbour who does wrong
613_mislabel_flags.note: Only C0616 (Mosaic Command) itemizes it, though the same verse's prohibitions are Torah Law; it reads as a standing duty.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Honour the aged and the wise (rise before them)
613_mislabel_flags.note: Only Mosaic Command records C0639 and C0640 itemize it; a standing conduct rule like Torah Law C0595 (revere parents).

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Honour father and mother
613_mislabel_flags.note: C0153 is typed Command; the companion 'Revere father and mother' (Lev 19:3, C0595) is Torah Law.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Circumcise sons (males) on the eighth day
613_mislabel_flags.note: Genesis record C0036 (record type Law, no Mosaic type); the Lev 12:3 eighth-day restatement is held only by passage group torah-leviticus-12-1.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Flog the guilty as the court prescribes
613_mislabel_flags.note: Judicial penalty filed as Instruction; comparable penalty rules (C1182, C1089, C1193) are Torah Law.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Bury the executed person on the day of execution
613_mislabel_flags.note: Standing rule filed as Instruction while its twin in the same sentence, C1120, is Torah Law.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Do not make an idol for oneself (for worship)
613_mislabel_flags.note: C0147 is Command (also holds Ex 34:17, Deut 27:15); Lev 19:4, 26:1 idol-making clauses unitemized, while Lev 26:1 pillar/stone bans are Torah Law.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Do not make an idol, even for others to worship
613_mislabel_flags.note: Lev 19:4's cast-gods clause has no own record; only Decalogue C0147 (Command, includes Exod 34:17 molten gods) states it. C0596 covers turning.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Do not bow down to an idol
613_mislabel_flags.note: Decalogue ban typed Command; the Ex 23:24 bowing clause sits in C0241 (imitation, Law); penalty AUD-05-17-5 is Torah Law.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Do not worship idols in their customary manner
613_mislabel_flags.note: Typed Command (with Deut 5:9, 7:16); the penalty for serving other gods, AUD-05-17-5, is Torah Law.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Do not make a covenant with the seven nations
613_mislabel_flags.note: C0244 (with Ex 34:12, 15) is a historical direction; the seven-nations judgment AUD-05-20-17 is typed Torah Law.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Do not show mercy or favor to idolaters
613_mislabel_flags.note: C0997 is a historical direction, though AUD-05-20-17 labels the same devotion judgment (20:17-18) Torah Law.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Do not let idolaters dwell in the land
613_mislabel_flags.note: Historical direction framed as a removal judgment; the comparable AUD-05-20-17 (Deut 20:17-18) is typed Torah Law.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Do not intermarry with idolatrous nations
613_mislabel_flags.note: Standing marriage prohibition filed as historical direction; comparable assembly restrictions (23:3-4, C1143-C1144) are Torah Law.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Do not offer peace to Ammon and Moab
613_mislabel_flags.note: Perpetual prohibition ('all your days for ever') filed as historical direction; the adjacent assembly rules C1144-C1147 are Torah Law.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Do not fear the enemy in battle
613_mislabel_flags.note: Saints 7:21 reads 'not be wounded'; C1091 (20:1-4) is historical direction amid Deut 20 war laws labeled Law/Instruction.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Do not swear a vain (needless) oath by God's name
613_mislabel_flags.note: C0150 is typed Command; the companion false-oath ban of Lev 19:12 (C0604) is Torah Law.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Do not leave the sanctuary unguarded
613_mislabel_flags.note: Only positive Command charges (C0774 holds 18:5; C0772 Levite guard); Maimonides reads 'keep the charge' as forbidding an unguarded sanctuary.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Do not put oil on the sotah's meal offering
613_mislabel_flags.note: Exact parallel ban for the sinner's flour offering (C0418, Lev 5:11) is Torah Law, but this one is Instruction.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Do not put frankincense on the sotah's meal offering
613_mislabel_flags.note: Exact parallel ban (C0419, Lev 5:11) is Torah Law, but the jealousy-offering ban is Instruction.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Do not make a bald spot in mourning for the dead
613_mislabel_flags.note: For Israel only topical study S126; Torah Law C0655 (Lev 21:5) covers priests only.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Do not eat blood
613_mislabel_flags.note: Only Genesis indexed record C0019 (adds Lev 7:26-27, Deut 12); no Torah Law record; Lev 17:10-12, 14 cited by no record.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Do not steal money or property stealthily
613_mislabel_flags.note: Lev 19:11's 'You shall not steal' has no own record; only Decalogue C0155 (Command) states it, which Maimonides reads as kidnapping.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Do not covet (scheme to acquire) another's property
613_mislabel_flags.note: Both records typed Command; the similar 'Do not covet the silver or gold on idols' (C0999) is Torah Law.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Do not testify falsely
613_mislabel_flags.note: Typed Command; related witness laws C0216 (Ex 23:1) and C1089 (Deut 19:19) are Torah Law.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Do not murder
613_mislabel_flags.note: Decalogue ban typed Command; the murder penalty rules (AUD-04-35-16, C1083, C0950) are Torah Law.

613_mislabel_flags.statement: Do not have relations with another man's wife
613_mislabel_flags.note: Only the Decalogue record C0154 (Mosaic Command) holds Lev 18:20; Lev 18's other unions are Torah Law. C0646 gives only the penalty.

label_conflicts.note: C0096 (12:8–9) includes the not-raw clause C0097 states. Narrow C0096 to the positive manner (roasted, with unleavened bread, bitter herbs); labels differ.
C0096 (12:8–9) includes the not-boiled clause C0098 states. Narrow C0096 to the positive manner of roasting and eating; Instruction vs Law on one clause.
Ban on eating torn flesh and its disposal to dogs are one rule's two halves; disposal is no rite step, so Instruction is unexplained.
If 'not bear sin because of him' means guilt from failing to reprove, it is reproof's negative; Command vs Law is then unexplained.
Both direct the Levites' portion from their tithe; C0884 adds 'best'. Narrow C0883 to 18:26–28 or merge; labels and classifications differ.
Both cover the same execution (13:10–11); C1024 only adds who strikes first. Narrow C1025 to the sentence (13:11) or merge; labels differ.
Following the court's judgment and not turning aside are one standing rule's two forms; Instruction vs Law is unexplained.
'Do not leave overnight' and 'bury the same day' are one standing rule's two forms; Instruction vs Law is unexplained.
Burial duty vs its negative (C1122, which duplicates C1120); Instruction vs Law for one rule is unexplained.
Ban on disregarding vs safekeeping found property are the rule's two sides; safekeeping is a standing duty, so Instruction is unexplained.
'Go outside the camp' and 'do not enter it' are one exclusion's two forms; a purity rule, not a rite step, so the labels conflict.
Deut 6:14 repeats the first commandment's ban on other gods; fold into C0146 (Mosaic Command) as Additional Scripture; C0995 is labelled Torah Law.
